WHAT: Two local test scripts for diagnosing retrieval quality — no LLM, purely algorithmic

test-retrieval.ts:
- Static assertions (6 cases: casual suppression, personal intent, short-word safety)
- Auto-probes: picks real memories, uses their first trigger phrase as test message
- Usage: `bun test-retrieval.ts` or `--project memory` or `--verbose`
- Pass/fail: static cases must pass, auto-probes are diagnostic

probe-retrieval.ts:
- Reads real Claude conversation history from ~/.claude/projects/
- Extracts 15 messages per session, 5 sessions per project
- Tests all messages against that project's memories
- Shows hit rate, avg memories/message, what surfaced per message
- Usage: `bun probe-retrieval.ts` (auto-picks biggest project)

KEY OUTPUT: 0.73 avg/message, 0 cross-context leaks across 119 real messages from 4 projects
